description: WPS Presentation is open with '/home/ga/Documents/presentations/performance.pptx'. Open the Design tab in the ribbon. Apply any built-in WPS design theme from the theme gallery to all slides in the presentation. The theme gallery is visible in the Design tab — click any named theme (such as 'Blue Waves', 'Facet', 'Ion', etc.) to apply it. The theme will change the color scheme and background of all slides. Save the file using Ctrl+S or File > Save.
